about.heroDesc: Your corporate partner for wholesale supply and distribution to licence-holding businesses on the European side of Istanbul.
about.expTitle: An Experienced and Trusted Name in the Industry
about.expP1: LEMARS Food & Beverage is a company with over 20 years of sector experience providing wholesale supply and distribution services on the European side of Istanbul, operating under a wholesale alcoholic beverage sales certificate issued by the Turkish Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.
about.expP2: The market and operational knowledge we have gained over the years gives our business partners a planning advantage. The know-how we have accumulated at every stage, from supply chain management to logistics planning, is our most valuable asset in the sector.
about.expP3: With our qualified workforce and modern management approach, we provide uninterrupted delivery to more than 1,800 licence-holding points of sale such as restaurants, hotels, grocery stores and licensed retailers.
about.comp1Desc: Over 20 years of accumulated knowledge enables us to accurately assess market dynamics and deliver added value to our partners.
about.comp2Desc: By closely following changing market conditions and business demand, we support our partners in stock and order planning.
about.comp3Desc: We efficiently manage the entire process from supplier to point of sale, reducing the operational burden on businesses.
about.comp4Desc: Through order management, delivery planning and point-of-sale visits, we manage a steady supply flow to 1,800+ licence-holding points.
about.comp5Desc: With our team of industry experts and contemporary management practices, we deliver fast decision-making and solution-oriented service.
about.adv1Title: Broad Supplier Network and Product Range
about.adv1Desc: With our broad network of domestic and imported suppliers and more than 400 product lines, we meet businesses' supply needs from a single source.
about.adv2Desc: Our flexible and robust distribution infrastructure covers all of the European side of Istanbul with same-day delivery.
about.adv3Desc: Our modern management approach creates customised supply plans and proactively resolves issues for every client.
about.adv4Desc: We draw on over 20 years of experience in market knowledge, business demand and supply chain management.
about.adv5Desc: Our customer-focused team of specialists provides professional support at every stage of the process.
about.adv6Desc: Our activities are carried out under a wholesale alcoholic beverage sales certificate, on a recorded and auditable basis.
about.ctaDesc: Contact us for corporate information about your supply and distribution processes.

section1.title: 1. General Provisions
section1.content: This website has been prepared solely for informational purposes by LEMARS Food & Beverage Industry and Trade Limited Company ("LEMARS"). By accessing and using this website, you agree to the following terms and conditions.

section2.title: 2. Purpose of the Website
section2.content: This site does not advertise alcoholic beverages, promote them to consumers, sell them or act as an intermediary for their sale. The content is for corporate information purposes and has been prepared having regard to the advertising and promotion prohibitions of Article 6 of Law No. 4250, Law No. 4733 on the Regulation of the Tobacco, Tobacco Products and Alcohol Market, and the Regulation on the Procedures and Principles Governing the Sale and Presentation of Tobacco Products and Alcoholic Beverages (in particular Articles 11 and 20).

section3.title: 3. Age Restriction
section3.content: This website is intended for persons over the age of 18. On entry you are asked to declare that you are over 18; this is a self-declaration control and does not technically verify your age. An age declaration alone does not create an exemption as regards the compliance of the site's content with applicable legislation; the content has additionally been restricted.

section4.title: 4. Intellectual Property Rights
section4.content: All content, designs, logos, and text on this website are the property of LEMARS Food & Beverage and are protected by copyright law. Unauthorized copying, reproduction, or distribution is prohibited.

section5.title: 5. Right to Amend
section5.content: LEMARS Food & Beverage reserves the right to modify these terms of use without prior notice. The current terms are always published on this page.

section6.title: 7. Governing Law
section6.content: These terms of use are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey. The courts and enforcement offices of Istanbul shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes.

section7.title: 6. Orders and Sales
section7.content: No alcoholic beverages are sold, no orders are taken and no price notifications are made through this website. A supply relationship is established only with businesses holding a valid sales certificate, through our physical place of business. Online sales to consumers are prohibited under applicable legislation.

section1.title: 1. Data Controller
section1.content: As LEMARS Food & Beverage Industry and Trade Limited Company, we process your personal data in the capacity of data controller under Turkish Law No. 6698, the Personal Data Protection Law ("KVKK"), for the purposes described below.

section2.title: 2. Personal Data Collected

section3.title: 3. Purpose of Data Processing
section3.content: Your personal data is processed solely for the following purposes:

section4.title: 4. Data Transfer
section4.content: Your personal data is not shared with third parties other than as required by law and with the service providers set out below. Contact form messages are delivered via an e-mail delivery service and are also pushed as a notification to our corporate WhatsApp line; where you have given explicit consent, Google Analytics is used for analytics cookies. Because the servers of these service providers are located abroad, your data is transferred abroad within the meaning of Article 9 of Law No. 6698. The transfer is limited to responding to your request and measuring use of the site.

section5.title: 5. Cookie Policy
section5.content: This website may use cookies to improve the user experience and measure site usage. Essential cookies are required for the site to function properly. Analytics cookies are only activated with your explicit consent; no marketing cookies are used.

section6.title: 6. Your Rights
section6.content: Under Article 11 of the KVKK (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law), you have the following rights:
list: To learn whether your personal data is being processed
To request information about the processing if your data has been processed
To learn the purpose of data processing and whether your data is being used in accordance with its purpose
To know the third parties to whom your data has been transferred, domestically or abroad
To request correction if your data has been processed inaccurately or incompletely
To request deletion or destruction of your data under the conditions specified in Article 7 of the KVKK

section7.title: 7. Contact
section7.content: To exercise your rights under the KVKK, you may contact us at info@lemarsgida.com.

section1.content: The information on this website is provided by LEMARS Gıda İçecek Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi for corporate information purposes. This site does not sell or market alcoholic beverages, promote them to consumers, or act as an intermediary for their sale.

section2.title: 2. Statement on the Advertising and Promotion Prohibition
section2.content: The content of this site has been prepared having regard to the advertising, promotion and inducement prohibitions of Article 6 of Law No. 4250, Law No. 4733 and the Regulation on the Procedures and Principles Governing the Sale and Presentation of Tobacco Products and Alcoholic Beverages. The site contains no content intended to encourage or induce the consumption of alcoholic beverages, no tasting or aroma descriptions, no product or packaging images, no brand logos, no price notifications and no campaign announcements. This statement does not constitute a guarantee that the content complies with applicable legislation in all circumstances; legislative developments are monitored on an ongoing basis.

LEMARS Food & Beverage shall not be held liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from the use of information on this website.
